corrections.caveats: The README performance tables name the CPUs tested but not the compiler version or flags; they note only that long-input measurements used the RAPIDHASH_UNROLLED macro. The bench/ harness (adapted from xxHash's benchHash, GPLv2-licensed Makefile) defaults to CFLAGS -O3, but nothing confirms that setting produced the published table. xxh3 wins peak throughput on Ryzen 9700X (78 vs 68 GB/s) and ties on latency there. Independent corroboration: rurban/smhasher's summary table (default AMD Ryzen 5 3350G) lists rapidhash at 21513.71 MiB/s and 22.04 cycles/hash vs xxh3 at 20853.74 MiB/s and 29.46 cycles/hash (compiler/flags not stated there either).

notes: All README numbers match the record, including the ~45% M4 derivation (71 vs 49 GB/s).
